target.title: Add deep regression review prototype
target.body:
Closes #439.

## TLDR

- Adds a default-off OpenClaw deep-regression review prototype for high-risk PRs.
- GitNexus is optional and advisory. GitHub diff/checkout context remains authoritative.
- All concrete ClawSweeper code findings found during this PR loop are fixed on the current head.
- Latest ClawSweeper P1, broad secret detection before GitNexus prompt insertion, is fixed in `d601ec6` with regression coverage.
- Current-head local focused validation is clean on `d601ec6`; remote CI is green and the PR is merge-clean.
- No 1M-context or release-safety claim is made. Context-window size is telemetry only.

Current head: `d601ec6a34d77588c0acfdfe4079587bc8977619`

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Diff["GitHub diff + live checkout"] --> Risk["OpenClaw risk classifier"]
  Risk -->|"standard"| Standard["Normal ClawSweeper review"]
  Risk -->|"core/auth/runtime/etc."| Deep["Adversarial deep-regression pass"]
  Graph["Optional GitNexus packet"] -->|"advisory hints only"| Deep
  Deep --> Report["deepRegressionReview output"]
  Report -->|"blocked / needs_attention"| Human["Maintainer redesign or proof review"]
```

## What Changed

- Adds deterministic OpenClaw high-risk classification for core/runtime/auth/session/security/provider-routing/release/config surfaces.
- Adds an optional GitNexus advisory context packet behind `CLAWSWEEPER_GITNEXUS_CONTEXT=1`.
- Adds packet freshness, exact packet SHA, stable content SHA, byte budget, omitted-context accounting, redaction hash, and fail-closed behavior for secret-like output.
- Extends the decision schema, prompt contract, report frontmatter, public rendering, and close/automation gating with `deepRegressionReview`.
- Adds context-window telemetry via `CLAWSWEEPER_EXPECTED_CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS`; unknown stays `unknown`.
- Adds review-cache safety so graph-context changes bust cached reports, while identical graph context generated at different times can reuse prior review content.
- Adds command-status cleanup so repeated `@clawsweeper re-review` commands do not leave stale ClawSweeper status comments for older heads.
- Adds maintainer-facing documentation: `docs/deep-regression-review.md`.

## ClawSweeper Finding Map

| Finding / gate | Resolution |
| --- | --- |
| Raw GitNexus failure output could reach prompt/report fields | Fixed. Nonzero `gitnexus list/query` output is omitted and represented by status plus output hash; secret-like output fails closed. |
| GitNexus output detector missed common credentials | Fixed in `d601ec6`. The detector now covers PEM/private keys, AWS-style keys, JWT-like tokens, bearer tokens, OpenAI/GitHub/Stripe/Slack/npm/Google-style tokens, and generic credential assignments. |
| Literal fake credential fixtures triggered GitHub push protection | Fixed before push. Tests assemble secret-shaped values at runtime, so the branch does not store full secret-shaped literals. |
| GitNexus context missing from review cache state | Fixed. The review content digest includes graph enabled/freshness/content hash/alias/stale-policy/context-window state. |
| Packet hash was unstable because it included `generatedAt` | Fixed. Packet `sha256` remains exact evidence; `contentSha256` excludes run-local telemetry and is used for cache state. |
| Deep-regression blockers could still emit pass markers | Fixed. `blocked` or `needs_attention` deep-regression concerns now force `needs-human` markers and cannot pass automerge/autofix marker gates. |
| GitNexus packet building applied to non-OpenClaw PRs | Fixed. Packet building and graph-specific cache state are scoped to `openclaw/openclaw`. |
| Maintainer GitNexus/schema boundary | Committed as a proposed contract in `docs/deep-regression-review.md`; maintainers can accept, narrow, or remove it in normal review. |
| Current-head proof gate | Addressed with current-head focused local output and green remote CI below. Full local-range proof was attempted but local Codex API auth failed with 401 before review findings. |

## Current-Head Validation

Local commands run from `/Volumes/LEXAR/repos/clawsweeper` on `d601ec6a34d77588c0acfdfe4079587bc8977619`:

```bash
pnpm run build
node --test test/gitnexus-context.test.ts test/review-content-cache.test.ts test/pr-review-comment-risk.test.ts test/decision-parser.test.ts
pnpm run lint:src
pnpm run format:check
git diff --check
```

Current-head local output summary:

```text
pnpm run build: passed (tsgo -p tsconfig.json)
node --test ...: tests 71, pass 71, fail 0, duration_ms 139.687834
pnpm run lint:src: passed
pnpm run format:check: All matched files use the correct format.
git diff --check: passed with no output
```

Remote validation on `d601ec6`:

```text
pnpm check: SUCCESS
CodeQL / Analyze (actions): SUCCESS
CodeQL / Analyze (javascript-typescript): SUCCESS
Windows Codex launcher: SUCCESS
Socket Security / Pull Request Alerts: SUCCESS
Socket Security / Project Report: SUCCESS
Merge state: CLEAN
```

Evidence:

- Prior clean local-range proof for `caf54ba`: `/Volumes/LEXAR/Codex/evidence/clawsweeper-deep-regression/2026-07-09/issue-439/local-range-caf54ba/0.md`
- Exact-head local-range attempt for `d601ec6`: `/Volumes/LEXAR/Codex/evidence/clawsweeper-deep-regression/2026-07-09/issue-439/local-range-d601ec6/0.md`
- Exact-head local-range blocker: Codex API 401 in `/Volumes/LEXAR/Codex/evidence/clawsweeper-deep-regression/2026-07-09/issue-439/local-range-d601ec6/codex/0.1.codex.stdout.log`

## Maintainer Notes

GitNexus is a code graph/index. In this PR it only supplies optional related-code hints. It does not decide whether a PR is safe, and stale/missing/secret-like graph output lowers confidence or fails closed.

The latest durable ClawSweeper PR review on `d601ec6` found no code finding and cleared security. It still requests proof/maintainer boundary review. This body now includes current-head focused proof and green CI; a maintainer can re-run ClawSweeper if they want the durable bot comment refreshed.

## Remaining Decision

The remaining decision is product/security acceptance of the default-off GitNexus-backed deep-regression review contract. This PR improves review signal and confidence hygiene; it does not prove release readiness or guarantee bug-free releases.
